quotes.text: Train on two variations of 21 tasks and evaluate on three variations of the remaining 22 held-out tasks, with paraphrasing enabled throughout.

parsed.rationale: Experiment 4 holds out 22 tasks from memory training, and results shrink on held-out tasks. This is a train/test split for the memory component rather than a contamination check against model pretraining, and no canary, gating or overlap check is reported, so scored 1.
